mandatoryCriteria: Post comment: POST /api/v1/cards/:cardId/comments posts comment by workspace owner, project manager, or member; viewers receive 403 FORBIDDEN
Body validation: Body length 1 to 10,000 characters; trimmed non-empty
Atomic activity and outbox commit: Atomically writes comment, activity_log entry, and notification/outbox records in same transaction
Idempotency enforcement: POST /api/v1/cards/:cardId/comments enforces mandatory Idempotency-Key
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Comment posting with transactional outbox.
